answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 32253 Country: India Title: Online Survey Question: There is so many internet online company offering online job as 1. take part or filing online survey form of branded company as LG NOKIA etc. by wcich they can get cotomer's opinion to improve his product. for this survey they give us income and if we pramote him and refer it to other customer the give us rewards as gift or income 2. some company offering online job as viewing advertise of branded company by which they can get response and sell product better. for this viewing of advertisement they give us income and if we pramote him and refer it to other customer the give us rewards as gift or income. Both company are taking resistration charge for one year and after that they give online job we get income after deduction of goverment tax Our Question is that is this inincomeis legle as islamaic view Answer ID: 32253 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 936/L=349/TL=1432) After studying the details of the survey companies, we concluded that their system is not based on Shariah principles; hence, one should avoid being a member and getting benefit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
